description: Phase 5 of the covariance-kernel proof epic (qou-x631): the Fulman-analogue Stein exchangeable pair for the 3-cycle. Built the Plancherel-reversible down-up chain on partitions of n (down: remove corner, prob dim μ/dim λ; up: add box, prob dim λ*/(n dim μ)); reversibility verified. The content-power central characters ω_j=Σc^j−E_P[Σc^j] are eigenfunctions for j=1 (Σc, transposition, Fulman's object, τ₁=2/n) and j=2 (Σc²=ω₃, 3-cycle, OUR object, τ₃=3/n) — the direct k=2 analogue of Fulman's k=1; j≥3 mix (not needed). So E[ω₃(λ*)|λ]=(1−3/n)ω₃(λ), the exact hypothesis of Fulman's Stein bound. Reversibility + eigenfunction give the EXACT identity E_P[Δf·ω₃]=−τ₃·Cov_P(f,ω₃)=−(3/n)cov(n)/n! (Δf=f(λ*)−f(λ)), verified n≤9. Hence the kernel is reformulated LOCALLY: cov(n)≤0 ⇔ E_P[(f(λ*)−f(λ))ω₃(λ)]≥0 (correlation of the one-step dimension increment with the content-spread). Does NOT yet close the sign (needs the explicit increment evaluation or a joint Stein CLT with effective Berry–Esseen error — genuine further work, not in the literature for the 3-cycle×dimension covariance). scope-(a); no fit; nothing wired; no c_k; L2 2/7.
